W1.name: relationship mechanism decomposition
actions: Using only the existing 300 comparison draws, decompose R0-to-RS and R0-to-RSC profit differences by year, crop, edge and sold-versus-excess component
Report which synthetic edges affect demand and where production or sales caps make the effect irrelevant
Do not optimize or generate new randomness

W2.name: local-neighbourhood challenge to B0
actions: N0: fix the B0 binary planting pattern and optimize only continuous areas and sales for at most 2 minutes
N10: optimize M1-NET on the existing RSC training set with at most 10 binary activation changes from B0 for at most 4 minutes
N30: same model with at most 30 binary activation changes for at most 6 minutes
Warm-start every run from B0; retain all bounds, gaps and failures
W2.purpose: Test whether the previous global MILP gap hid a useful nearby plan without rerunning the unresolved full M2 model

W3.name: relationship-strength and sales-assumption sensitivity
actions: Evaluate fixed valid plans at 0.5x, 1x and 2x cross-price coefficients using the stored comparison draws and the same plus-or-minus 10 percent clip
Re-evaluate D0, D05 and D10 demand allocations and S1/S2 sales rules without re-solving
Record ranking reversals as assumption sensitivity

W4.name: one-time holdout and independent verification
actions: After the pre-holdout candidate is fixed, generate the reserved 500 underlying draws with seed 20250308 and evaluate R0, RS and RSC, for 1500 world evaluations
Use each underlying draw as one independent paired unit when calculating the mean-difference confidence interval
Independently reconstruct agricultural constraints, profit, relationship multipliers and all reported metrics without importing the solver or generator
Do not tune or re-solve after viewing holdout results

pre_holdout_challenger_rule.mean_gain_over_B0: >= 0.1 percent on the existing 900 world evaluations
pre_holdout_challenger_rule.world_requirement: RSC mean improves and at least two of R0/RS/RSC have nonnegative mean difference
pre_holdout_challenger_rule.tie_rule: choose the smaller local neighbourhood; otherwise keep B0

replace_B0_only_if: 95 percent paired mean-difference interval lower bound > 0
holdout worst10 mean is not more than 0.1 percent below B0
final_holdout_rule.sensitivity_rule: If the choice reverses between 0.5x and 2x relationship strength, keep B0 and report dependence on synthetic strength unless the user later authorizes a different policy
final_holdout_rule.fallback: Keep B0 and report that the tested local and sensitivity evidence did not justify changing the Q2 plan

budget.hard_boundary: Stop unfinished work at 25 minutes; do not borrow time or start another solve

forbidden: change the synthetic graph, marginal ranges, coefficients or plus-or-minus 10 percent clip after seeing results
use the 500 holdout before fixing the challenger
create a Q3 result workbook not specified by the problem
freeze Q3 or enter paper writing

result.excluded_result: N30 used N10 rather than B0 as the Hamming reference and is excluded without rerun after holdout access
